name: Cooper Island

categories.label: Sail ship steps past last harbor/bay space
categories.hint: 1 point per step each sail ship moved past the last harbor or bay water space.

categories.label: Royal order cards
categories.hint: Per card with your worker: stage 1 = 3, stage 2 = 5, stage 3 = 8 (not cumulative); card values may differ, see p.27. Enter the sum.

categories.label: Flagged building cards fulfilled
categories.labelVi: Thẻ công trình có nhiệm vụ
categories.hint: Points printed on each face-up flagged building card whose task you completed.

categories.label: Leftover items
categories.hint: 1 point per 5 items: coins and cubes on storage spots, cartographer steps left, double landscape tiles in reserve.

tiebreakers.description: Fewer uncharted spaces on your peninsula (with and without ruins)

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Final scoring has 5 steps on the final scoring overview card. Royal order values are usually 3/5/8 but entered as a sum. Solo vs Cooper bot not modelled.

sources.title: Cooper Island rulebook (Frosted Games)
sources.section: End of the game (p.24) and appendix p.27
